title: Unit 5 · Part 2
topic: Food and drink, Common verb phrases 1, Words and phrases 5A, Words and phrases 5B

words.definition: food from animals, e.g. beef or chicken
words.example: My brother doesn't eat meat.

words.definition: round things from chickens that you can eat
words.example: I have two eggs for breakfast.
words.example_ru: На завтрак я ем два яйца.

words.definition: a thick white food made from milk
words.example: She has a yogurt every morning.

words.definition: plants you eat, e.g. carrots and onions
words.example: Eat a lot of vegetables. They're good for you.

words.definition: a clear drink with no colour
words.example: Can I have a glass of water, please?

words.definition: a drink made from oranges
words.example: I have orange juice with my breakfast.
words.example_ru: На завтрак я пью апельсиновый сок.

words.definition: an alcoholic drink made from grapes
words.example: They drink red wine with dinner.
words.example_ru: За ужином они пьют красное вино.

words.definition: an alcoholic drink, often yellow
words.example: My dad has a beer after work.

words.definition: to have your home in a flat
words.example: We live in a flat in the city centre.
words.example_ru: Мы живём в квартире в центре города.

words.definition: to hear programmes on the radio
words.example: My mum listens to the radio in the car.

words.definition: to look at and understand the news in a newspaper
words.example: My grandfather reads the newspaper every morning.

words.definition: to eat burgers, pizzas, etc.
words.example: I don't eat fast food very often.

words.definition: to have tea as a drink
words.example: In England people drink tea with milk.
words.example_ru: В Англии пьют чай с молоком.

words.definition: to use the English language when you talk
words.example: Do you speak English?

words.definition: to wish to have a coffee
words.example: I'm tired. I want a coffee.

words.definition: to own a dog as a pet
words.example: We have a dog called Max.
words.example_ru: У нас есть собака по кличке Макс.

words.definition: to think cats are nice
words.example: My sister likes cats, but I don't.
words.example_ru: Моя сестра любит кошек, а я нет.

words.definition: to have a job in a bank
words.example: My father works in a bank.

words.definition: to learn the Spanish language
words.example: I study Spanish at university.

words.definition: to attend lessons where you learn English
words.example: I go to English classes on Tuesdays.
words.example_ru: По вторникам я хожу на уроки английского.

words.definition: to have to get a different car
words.example: Our car is very old. We need a new car.
words.example_ru: Наша машина очень старая. Нам нужна новая.

words.definition: on some occasions, not always
words.example: I sometimes have tea in the morning.

words.definition: you say this when you don't want to eat
words.example: No pizza for me, thanks. I'm not hungry.
words.example_ru: Мне пиццу не надо, спасибо. Я не голоден.

words.definition: before the usual time
words.example: I get up early on weekdays.

words.definition: good for your body
words.example: Fruit is healthy food.

words.definition: done in the same way for a long time
words.example: Fish and chips is a traditional English dish.
words.example_ru: Рыба с картошкой — традиционное английское блюдо.

words.definition: that matters a lot
words.example: Breakfast is an important meal.

words.definition: inside a small restaurant for drinks and snacks
words.example: We often meet in a café after school.
words.example_ru: Мы часто встречаемся в кафе после школы.

words.definition: at the place where you do your job
words.example: My mum is at work now.

words.definition: a type of tea popular in Asia
words.example: In Japan people drink green tea.

words.definition: a large amount or number of
words.example: She eats a lot of fruit.

words.definition: a company from the UK
words.example: I work for a British company.

words.definition: a journey by plane
words.example: Our flight is at 10 a.m.

words.definition: cars, buses, etc. on the road
words.example: There's a lot of traffic in the city centre.

words.definition: the place at an airport where you get on a plane
words.example: Please go to gate 12.

words.definition: studying at a university
words.example: My brother is at university in London.
words.example_ru: Мой брат учится в университете в Лондоне.

words.word: Do you want fish or pasta?
words.definition: a question to offer a choice of food
words.example: Do you want fish or pasta? — Pasta, please.
words.example_ru: Вам рыбу или пасту? — Пасту, пожалуйста.

words.word: I need to go to the toilet.
words.definition: you say this when you have to use the toilet
words.example: Excuse me, I need to go to the toilet.

words.definition: a question about the arrival time
words.example: What time do we arrive? — At six o'clock.
words.example_ru: Во сколько мы прибываем? — В шесть часов.

words.definition: you say this when the extra money is for the other person
words.example: Here's twenty pounds. Keep the change.
words.example_ru: Вот двадцать фунтов. Сдачи не надо.

words.definition: a card you need to get on a plane
words.example: Can I see your passport and boarding pass, please?
words.example_ru: Можно ваш паспорт и посадочный талон?

words.definition: you say this when something good happens that you didn't expect
words.example: Flowers for me? What a nice surprise!
words.example_ru: Цветы для меня? Какой приятный сюрприз!
